scenes.text: Hello little friend! I'm Tiko, and today we're going on an amazing journey about transitions. Have you ever wondered what it's like when things change around you? Well, we're going to explore that together in a fun and exciting way. Are you ready to discover how to handle new situations with courage and a big smile? I'm so excited to be with you on this adventure. Let's start our journey together!

Now, let's think about what a transition is. A transition is when something changes, like when you move from playing with toys to eating dinner. It's like when the sun goes down and the moon comes up. Transitions happen every day, and they can be big or small. Do you remember the last time you had to start a new school year? That's a transition too! Let's find out how we can make these changes fun and exciting.

Remember when we talked about transitions? Well, one way to make them easier is by taking deep breaths. Breathing helps us feel calm and ready for anything new. Let's practice together: breathe in slowly through your nose, and then out through your mouth. Great job! Doing this can help you feel ready for whatever change comes your way. Keep practicing, and you'll become a breathing expert!

You're doing amazing with your breathing! Now let's think about how we can make transitions fun. Imagine you're a superhero who can handle anything that comes your way. You have a special cape that gives you the power to adapt to changes. Let's put on our imaginary capes and say, 'I can do it!' You have the power to tackle any new situation with bravery and confidence. Isn't that exciting?

Let's continue our adventure by thinking about routines. Routines are like a cozy blanket that makes you feel safe and secure. They help us know what to expect each day, like brushing your teeth before bed or having breakfast in the morning. Do you have a favorite routine that you do every day? Routines can help us feel ready for transitions because they give us a sense of stability. Let's think about how we can add fun to our routines!

Now, let's create a fun routine together. Imagine it's morning, and it's time to get ready for the day. First, we stretch our arms high up to the sky like a tall tree. Then, we brush our teeth, making sure to reach every corner. Next, we put on our favorite clothes and do a little dance. Finally, we have a yummy breakfast to give us energy for the day. Doesn't that sound like a fun way to start the day? Let's try it out!

You're doing such a great job with your new routine! Remember, every time you try something new, you're learning and growing. It's like planting a seed and watching it turn into a beautiful flower. You have the power to make any transition a fun and exciting adventure. Keep exploring and discovering new things every day. You're a superstar at handling changes!

I have a question for you! What is something new that you would like to try? Maybe it's learning to ride a bike or trying a new food. Whatever it is, remember that you have the courage to give it a go. Can you think of one thing you'd like to do? It's always fun to try new things and see where they take us. I'm curious to hear what you come up with!

Now that we've talked about trying new things, let's think about how we can be brave. Being brave means facing something new even if it feels a little scary at first. It's like when you first learned to swim. At first, it might have felt a bit strange, but now you love splashing in the water! Remember, it's okay to feel nervous, and it's okay to ask for help when you need it.

Let's practice being brave together. Imagine we're going on a big adventure in a magical forest. There are tall trees and friendly animals. Sometimes, the path might look a bit tricky, but with each step, we feel braver and braver. Can you imagine us walking confidently through the forest, smiling at every new sight? Remember, you're never alone on your adventures. You have friends and family who are there to support you.

You're doing so well on our adventure! It's amazing how brave you are. Every time you try something new, you're adding to your collection of adventures. Think of all the wonderful stories you'll have to share! Keep being curious and exploring the world around you. You're an explorer, ready to discover all the wonders out there. I'm so proud of you!

Let's continue by thinking about how we can help others with transitions. Sometimes, our friends might feel unsure about changes too. We can be there to support them and share what we've learned. Maybe you can teach them the breathing exercise we practiced earlier. Or you can invite them to join your fun routine. Helping others makes us feel good inside and shows them they're not alone.

Remember when we imagined being superheroes? Well, superheroes also help their friends. Imagine you have a friend who's feeling a bit scared about starting a new school. You can share your superhero cape with them, and together, you can face the new adventure. It's always wonderful to share your courage and kindness. Are you ready to be a superhero for your friends?

Now, let's think about what we can do when we feel a bit unsure. What are some things that make you feel better? Maybe it's talking to someone you trust or hugging your favorite stuffed animal. It's important to know that everyone feels unsure sometimes, and there are lots of ways to feel better. Can you think of something that helps you feel calm and happy?

Wow, what an adventure we've had today, learning all about transitions! Remember, changes can be exciting and full of new opportunities. With your superhero cape, your breathing exercises, and your fun routines, you're ready for anything. I'm so proud of you for being brave and curious. Thank you for joining me on this journey. Until next time, keep exploring and having fun. Goodbye, my little friend!
